data.title: 出框式形态
data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"image-text-2","attrs":{"id":"imageText_J_zPX","src":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/hxmyseva_a71ca86f620597df282ac34e9d0915f4.png","caption":"朋友圈出框式营销","naturalWidth":750,"naturalHeight":1624,"imgAlign":"right"},"content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"产品介绍"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"一种通过打破传统营销边框限制，将素材进行创造出更加沉浸和立体的视觉效果的营销形式，支持自定义出框元素，为品牌提供创意发挥空间，通过极强的视觉冲击力为品牌和产品带来更高的关注度。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"售卖方式"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"支持合约售卖。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"如有投放意向，可以联系你的行业 / 渠道运营经理，或拨打我们的销售热线获取帮助。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"销售热线："},{"type":"telphone","attrs":{"id":"telphone_JQ5-_","telphone":4000617816},"marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}]}]}]}]}
